sources.title: OmniVoice: Free AI Voice Generator & Voice Cloning
sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a free, open-source AI voice generator that supports 646 languages. It converts text to natural-sounding speech, clones voices from a short audio sample (zero-shot Voice Cloning), or creates a voice from a text description alone (Voice Design).

sources.title: Kosmaster/OmniVoice · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it delivers high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design.
